class.name: OcgImeshtoolsContext
class.brief_description: Interface class representing context of BRepMesh algorithm. Intended to cache discrete model and instances of tools for its processing.
class.description: ! Interface class representing context of BRepMesh algorithm. ! Intended to cache discrete model and instances of tools for ! its processing.

method.name: IMeshTools_Context
method.description: Constructor.

method.name: BuildModel
method.description: Builds model using assigned model builder.

method.name: DiscretizeEdges
method.description: Performs discretization of model edges using assigned edge discret algorithm.

method.name: HealModel
method.description: Performs healing of discrete model built by DiscretizeEdges() method using assigned healing algorithm.

method.name: PreProcessModel
method.description: Performs pre-processing of discrete model using assigned algorithm. Performs auxiliary actions such as cleaning shape from old triangulation.

method.name: DiscretizeFaces
method.description: Performs meshing of faces of discrete model using assigned meshing algorithm.

method.name: PostProcessModel
method.description: Performs post-processing of discrete model using assigned algorithm.

method.name: Clean
method.description: Cleans temporary context data.

method.name: GetModelBuilder
method.description: Gets instance of a tool to be used to build discrete model.

method.name: SetModelBuilder
method.description: Sets instance of a tool to be used to build discrete model.

method.name: GetEdgeDiscret
method.description: Gets instance of a tool to be used to discretize edges of a model.

method.name: SetEdgeDiscret
method.description: Sets instance of a tool to be used to discretize edges of a model.

method.name: GetModelHealer
method.description: Gets instance of a tool to be used to heal discrete model.

method.name: SetModelHealer
method.description: Sets instance of a tool to be used to heal discrete model.

method.name: GetPreProcessor
method.description: Gets instance of pre-processing algorithm.

method.name: SetPreProcessor
method.description: Sets instance of pre-processing algorithm.

method.name: GetFaceDiscret
method.description: Gets instance of meshing algorithm.

method.name: SetFaceDiscret
method.description: Sets instance of meshing algorithm.

method.name: GetPostProcessor
method.description: Gets instance of post-processing algorithm.

method.name: SetPostProcessor
method.description: Sets instance of post-processing algorithm.

method.name: GetParameters
method.description: Gets parameters to be used for meshing.

method.name: ChangeParameters
method.description: Gets reference to parameters to be used for meshing.

method.name: GetModel
method.description: Returns discrete model of a shape.
